episodes.title: Outsmarted
episodes.summary: The Gotham Garage crew tries to convert a 1964 Ford Thunderbird into a bonafide "rocket car" while giving a smart car the monster-truck treatment.

episodes.title: Green Is the New Black
episodes.summary: The team tackles a disassembled 1970 Chevy C-10 Fleetside in order to upgrade and trade it for a very valuable 1939 Zephyr car body.

episodes.title: Buggin' Out
episodes.summary: The crew tries to help out a friend at a steep discount with a Volkswagen Bug hot-rod upgrade. Mark gets overly creative with a T-bucket overhaul.

episodes.title: Junkyard Jewels
episodes.summary: Shawn and Mark get a sweet haul in a trade. Tony and Caveman tag-team a 1956 Chevy truck as Constance takes on a vintage VW microbus.

episodes.title: Frank'N'Bus
episodes.summary: Shawn locates an unconventional option for the bus engine but struggles to find a potential buyer. The crew gets some help from a hot-rod icon.

episodes.title: Life-Size
episodes.summary: The team aims to bring some Hot Wheels dreams to life in order to trade up for a rare Lincoln Futura replica. Shawn tries to rein in Mark's impulses.

episodes.title: Two for the Money
episodes.summary: The team members race to beat the clock in pursuit of a six-figure car. Mark's quest for a shop truck brings up meaningful memories.

episodes.title: Back to the Future
episodes.summary: The crew hustles to complete its ambitious upgrade of a 1955 Futura in time for a big auto show. Has Gotham Garage finally landed its six-figure car?

episodes.title: Electric Drag
episodes.summary: With the new shop open for business, the Gotham crew upgrades a 1953 Buick Special and then attempts a first: converting a gas engine to electric.

episodes.title: Totaled Disaster
episodes.summary: After suffering a massive setback, the crew focuses on flipping a souped-up motorcycle for some cash and finding their next great trade-up car.

episodes.title: Something Borrowed, Something Renewed
episodes.summary: As Shawn tries to rectify a deal gone bad, he pushes Mark to take on a sentimental project. The garage gets a chance to impress a splashy new client.

episodes.title: Motorboatin'
episodes.summary: Mark pushes more boundaries with his next two upgrades: overhauling a minivan so it's fit for rock stars and giving the Corvette treatment to a boat.

episodes.title: Later, Vaydor
episodes.summary: Shawn pursues the pieces he needs for a big trade while Mark puts his stamp on a kit car. The garage is treated to a surprise visitor: Caveman's mom.

episodes.title: The Crow
episodes.summary: Mark and Shawn finally make progress on a big deal. The crew fixes up a jalopy for a local race, then dives in to upgrade a legit vintage race car.

episodes.title: Deal with It
episodes.summary: As Mark overhauls a 1947 military-style Dodge Power Wagon, Shawn finds himself in the driver's seat when he surveys buyers for a 1960 Plymouth XNR.

episodes.title: Petersen Built
episodes.summary: The crew collectively weighs the opportunity of a lifetime — one that entails a great deal of prestige, but comes at a hefty cost.

episodes.title: Taking the High-End Road
episodes.summary: Business is booming for the Gotham crew, thanks to their recent recognition. Next up, they tackle turning a 1933 Ford replica into an art deco Delahaye.

episodes.title: The Italian Job
episodes.summary: To finance a costly job redo, the crew works on an El Camino cash car for a very demanding client while overhauling an International Harvester Scout.

episodes.title: Ride from the Ashes
episodes.summary: With everyone desperate for cash, Tony sees opportunity in a sentimental build. Shawn has a tough time finding a buyer for Mark's woody iteration.

episodes.title: Wheels on the Bus
episodes.summary: After some creative dealmaking, Shawn frets over Mark's hot take on a Bel Air. An academic achievement leads to a school bus upgrade for Caveman.

episodes.title: Hot Tub Time Machine
episodes.summary: As Mark presses to finish the hot-tub car and fulfill a commitment to some friends, Shawn persuades him to upgrade a vintage Ford pickup as insurance.

episodes.title: Lowrider Long Shot
episodes.summary: Mark harbors a lowrider vision for a vintage Impala, aimed at financing his high-concept car. As expected, the plans quickly get very elaborate.

episodes.title: Proof of Concept
episodes.summary: Mark's Hayabusa hopes are tied to his take on a Prius. Shawn tries to generate buzz ahead of an auction, but a real-world roadblock gets in his way.

episodes.title: Going, Going... Gone?
episodes.summary: The crew gets creative when social distancing hurts their hopes for a big payday. But Mark's high price demands may end up costing them even more.

episodes.title: Dumpster Divin'
episodes.summary: Eager to make some cash, the crew gets to work on two projects: creating a rat rod from scratch and making a customer`s Elite Laser 917 race-worthly.

episodes.title: All In the Family Wagon
episodes.summary: Shawn pitches the Gotham crew on an upgrade-and-trade deal involving a 1957 Chevy. Also on the agenda: an epic automotive mash-up.

episodes.title: Ready for Lift Off
episodes.summary: Mark and Shawn visit a salvage yard with hopes of trading in their newly completed '57 Chevy for some good old-fashioned Detroit iron.

episodes.title: Life of the Party Bus
episodes.summary: After losing money on a build, the Gotham crew gets back to doing what they do best by turning a 1954 Army ambulance into a blinged-out party bus.

episodes.title: Brotherly Love
episodes.summary: A broker representing a wealthy client shows interest in the yet-to-be-sold concept car combo. Later, Caveman pitches the crew on a project for a pal.

episodes.title: Riding High End
episodes.summary: The Gotham Garage crew sets out to turn a Lincoln Zephyr that`s seen better days into something truly special for a high-profile car show.

episodes.title: Go Big Rig or Go Home
episodes.summary: While the crew cranks on the Zephyr, Shawn pitches Mark on a deal involving a 1957 Kenworth big rig, just like the one Mark`s dad used to drive.

episodes.title: Special Delivery
episodes.summary: Pumped at the opportunity to be on the cover of a Speedway catalog, Mark and company pull out all the stops to get the Zephyr ready for its closeup.

episodes.title: Upping the Ante
episodes.summary: A tribute to the '69 Dodge Charger Daytona gives newbies Brian and Jake a chance to prove their skills. Shawn's plan could snare a Ferrari 458 Italia.

episodes.title: Hit the Gas
episodes.summary: The garage shifts into overdrive when a client wants a practically unheard-of modification to a Tesla. The transformed Dodge hits the track.

episodes.title: Captain Man-Cave
episodes.summary: In a jam, Shawn needs to find a buyer for an unusual hot rod. Gotham Garage takes on a venture that could lead to lucrative business in the future.

episodes.title: Franken-Tank
episodes.summary: Crew members air concerns about the garage's direction. A Harley Dyna gets a sleek, sinister look. Mark puzzles over a request for a novelty vehicle.

episodes.title: Upgrade and Paid?
episodes.summary: Tony has $10K to make over a dual-cab bricknose truck. The rat rod takes shape. Mark and Shawn look at a Ferrari 360 Spider — which comes with baggage.

episodes.title: Abandon Ship
episodes.summary: While waiting on the Ferrari news, the team turns an old pontoon boat into a floating party bus. A '69 Chevelle gets a 21st-century update.

episodes.title: Divine Design
episodes.summary: Mark takes a huge risk and the shop needs cash — fast. A customer returns to check out a revamped American classic with a $60K price tag.

episodes.title: Going For Broke
episodes.summary: Gotham makes bold modifications to the Ferrari while respecting its pedigree — a gamble that could make or break the shop. The car debuts at a party.

episodes.title: Doubling Down
episodes.summary: The garage snags two Ferraris at a steal, but client expectations strain creativity. Mark rolls the dice on a '32 Ford Roadster build for a casino.

episodes.title: The Future is Now
episodes.summary: A custom McLaren build puts Nick in a tough spot as Mark continues to fight for creative freedom. The team takes an iconic car back to the future — again.

episodes.title: Hot Air
episodes.summary: After a major announcement, the crew dives into an airborne passion project. Caveman brings in a project for his demolition derby pal, Dangerous Dan.

episodes.title: A Bit of a Stretch
episodes.summary: A whiskey maker's urgent request comes with a big payoff. Mark and Shawn spot a '70 Camaro SS at Dangerous Dan's salvage yard and try to strike a deal.

episodes.title: Muscle Memory
episodes.summary: When an upgrade-and-trade deal threatens to go sideways, Shawn and Constance team up to negotiate a 454 big-block swap. Mark ponders the garage's future.

episodes.title: A Green New Deal
episodes.summary: Tony builds a biodiesel conversion system for an eco-friendly Humvee. Mark revisits a project inspired by childhood memories of his father.

episodes.title: The Salvage Card
episodes.summary: The garage works overtime to satisfy a client and save a Jaguar XK-E trade. A deal for a '78 Ferrari 308 causes friction in the workplace.

episodes.title: Tomorrow's Throwback
episodes.summary: Mark shares his vision for the shop's future as the crew begins a "Magnum P.I."-inspired build. Later, Shawn tries to secure two legendary Hollywood cars.
